name: Advanced Search
description: Search for or open an article or publication using a document ID or a universal mnemonic code.

name: Sticky Action Bar
description: Keeps the action bar pinned in view for access to navigation and options while reading.

name: Alt Text View
description: Displays descriptive text that explains the content of an image.

name: Copy Text
description: Copies any selected paragraph or Bible verse to the clipboard with a single click.

name: Custom Table View
description: Enables customizable table styling for clearer data presentation.

name: Expand Width
description: Expands content to fill the entire screen width.

name: Language Count
description: Displays how many languages the current content is available in online.

name: Paragraph Link
description: Generates a shareable link for the selected paragraph or Bible verse.

name: Custom Media Player UI
description: Adjusts transparency of media player controls.

name: Customize Subtitles
description: Adjusts subtitle font size, style, and background.

name: Image Download
description: Downloads any image within an article with a single click.

name: Media Player Control Keys
description: Controls media playback using keyboard shortcuts.

name: Media Timestamp
description: Creates a link to the current media timestamp.

name: Second Display
description: Plays videos on a second display while controlling from the main display.

name: Video Transcript
description: Displays and allows searching/downloading a video transcript.
